scope: Logged cast counts are not user input counts; preserve evidence and refuse unsupported manual/triggered attribution. No detection of particular spell/talent.

budget.stop: No expansion after acceptance. New failures get at most two reserved reruns within original budget; stop at exhausted budget or repeated no-new-evidence failures.

samples.text: 已有WCL记录：元素萨烈焰震击36次，对照14次。27.674秒元素冲击cast与烈焰震击cast同毫秒，32.928秒闪电箭cast与烈焰震击cast同毫秒。没有按键记录或天赋触发核验。请给出最优先改进建议，能建议少按烈焰震击吗？
samples.expected: Cannot prioritize reducing manual casts from these counts; cannot prove triggered solely from simultaneity; propose bounded evidence check.

samples.text: 战士日志技能A为40个cast，对照20个；多次与技能B在同毫秒发生。没查触发机制。是否说明他手动按A太多，白白占用20个GCD？用两句话结论。
samples.expected: No manual/GCD attribution from raw counts or timestamps; preserve observed counts.

samples.text: 术士同一毫秒两条cast记录，伤害事件也重复，角色和目标相同。没有输入记录，能去重成一次主动按键，并认定另一条由天赋自动触发吗？请简短说明。
samples.expected: Cannot infer input identity or trigger by coincidence or drop records; request independent evidence.

samples.text: 只做统计：明确同一战斗完整窗口120秒，技能X记录10次成功cast，技能Y记录20次成功cast。各自每分钟多少次？不要评价操作。
samples.expected: 5 and10 logged casts per minute, no unsupported blame.
